analysis: The PR adds three optional diagnostic fields to the DaemonState snapshot: enabledModelsAtStart, enabledModelsAtLastSwitch and selectedModelRecovery. Changes are in DaemonStateFile.swift (properties at head lines 54-70, init params and assignments near 370-413) and DaemonState+Coding.swift (CodingKeys, decodeIfPresent and encodeIfPresent; head lines 13-15, 37-41, 79-83). All three use decodeIfPresent/encodeIfPresent, so older state files still decode and older readers ignore the new keys. The schema stays at 1, consistent with the file's header comment about the pre-update 0.9.15 watchdog. The new fields only carry model-ID lists and recovery entries. They add no secrets, keys, prompts, attestation material or authorization state. The file is a local diagnostic snapshot written atomically with write errors swallowed. It is not part of the coordinator wire contract (TB-002), the App Attest authorization (TB-011), the add-on socket (TB-012) or the prefix cache (T-041). No security regression is identified. Questions for integration: (1) The SelectedModelRecoveryEntry type is defined outside the supplied units. Confirm it carries only model IDs, timestamps and a bounded blocker reason, with no prompt content or paths that reveal sensitive data, and that its Codable conformance and unbounded array growth are safe. (2) Confirm the unseen producers of these fields (ProviderLoop and the switch command) populate them from trusted internal state. (3) Confirm the CLI/watchdog readers use the new fields only for display and never for serving or authorization decisions. The visible patch excerpt is truncated, but the range maps are complete and the full head text of the coding file was reviewed. The DaemonStateFile.swift head text was not supplied, only base and patch, which is sufficient for these additive changes.
